column4: A buyer asks "Is this still available?" and it is.
column5: Hi [name]! Yes, it's still available. [One useful fact: size, a measurement or condition]. You can buy it now or send me an offer.
column6: Hi Sam! Yes, it's still available. It's a size M, 54 cm pit to pit, worn twice with no flaws. You can buy it now or send me an offer.
column9: Add one fact the photos do not show. It answers their next question before they ask.

column4: The item has sold, but you have something close.
column5: Hi [name], sorry, this one has just sold. I have a similar [item] in [size or colour] in my shop if you'd like to have a look.
column6: Hi Sam, sorry, this one has just sold. I have a similar cardigan in size M in oat colour in my shop if you'd like to have a look.
column9: Point to your own shop on the app, never to another app or website.

column2: Buyer asks you to hold it
column4: A buyer asks you to keep the item for them until payday.
column5: Hi [name], thanks for asking! I can't hold items, so it goes to the first person who buys. If you're ready, you can buy it now with the Buy button.
column6: Hi Alex, thanks for asking! I can't hold items, so it goes to the first person who buys. If you're ready, you can buy it now with the Buy button.
column9: Holding items means other buyers cannot buy, and many holds never turn into a sale.

column4: An offer is well below your price, but the buyer seems keen.
column5: Thanks for your offer, [name]! The lowest I can do is £[price], because [one honest reason]. I've sent you a counter offer at £[price].
column6: Thanks for your offer, Jo! The lowest I can do is £24, because it's 100% wool and only worn twice. I've sent you a counter offer at £24.
column9: Send the counter with the app's offer button, then this short message. Pick your lowest price before you list.

column4: An offer is far too low and you do not want to counter yet.
column5: Thanks for the offer, [name]. I can't go that low on this one, but I'd be happy to accept £[price]. No worries if it's not for you!
column6: Thanks for the offer, Jo. I can't go that low on this one, but I'd be happy to accept £24. No worries if it's not for you!
column9: Stay friendly. A buyer who sent a low offer often comes back at a fair price.

column4: You accept an offer on Vinted.
column5: Thanks, [name]! I've accepted your offer of £[price]. Once you've paid, I'll send it within [X] working days with tracking through Vinted.
column6: Thanks, Priya! I've accepted your offer of £25. Once you've paid, I'll send it within 2 working days with tracking through Vinted.
column9: Only promise a sending time you can always meet.

column4: You accept an offer on Depop.
column5: Thanks, [name]! I've accepted your offer of £[price] plus postage. It's yours once you pay within 24 hours. I'll send it within [X] working days.
column6: Thanks, Priya! I've accepted your offer of £25 plus postage. It's yours once you pay within 24 hours. I'll send it within 2 working days.
column9: On Depop an accepted offer is not a sale until the buyer pays. Someone else can still buy at full price.

column4: The buyer comes back with another offer that is still under your lowest price.
column5: Thanks, [name]. £[price] is my lowest price for this one. It's listed at that price if you change your mind.
column6: Thanks, Jo. £22 is my lowest price for this one. It's listed at that price if you change your mind.
column9: Say your lowest price once, clearly, and stop there. Do not go lower after saying it.

column4: A buyer liked or asked about 2 or more of your items.
column5: Hi [name], I see you liked my [item 1] and [item 2]. If you take both, I can do £[bundle price] for the two (you save £[amount]) and they go in one parcel.
column6: Hi Mia, I see you liked my wool cardigan and wool scarf. If you take both, I can do £33 for the two (you save £5) and they go in one parcel.
column9: Weigh both items packed together first. A bundle may need a bigger parcel size.

column2: Buyer asks: do you do bundle deals?
column4: A buyer asks if you give a discount for buying more.
column5: Yes! I give [X]% off when you buy [2] or more items. Add them to a bundle (Vinted) or your bag (Depop) and the discount shows at checkout.
column6: Yes! I give 10% off when you buy 2 or more items. Add them to a bundle (Vinted) or your bag (Depop) and the discount shows at checkout.
column9: Turn on the app's bundle discount first, so the price changes by itself.

column4: A buyer offers too little for a bundle.
column5: Thanks, [name]! For the [number] items the lowest I can do is £[price]. That's £[amount] off the full price, and postage is one parcel. I've sent a counter offer.
column6: Thanks, Mia! For the 2 items the lowest I can do is £33. That's £5 off the full price, and postage is one parcel. I've sent a counter offer.
column9: Show the saving in money, not only in %. It is easier to understand.

column2: Accepted offer, buyer has not paid (Depop)
column4: You accepted an offer on Depop and a few hours have passed.
column5: Hi [name], just a reminder: your accepted offer of £[price] ends in about [X] hours. After that it goes back to the full price.
column6: Hi Priya, just a reminder: your accepted offer of £25 ends in about 6 hours. After that it goes back to the full price.
column9: Send it once. One reminder is helpful. More than one feels like pressure.

column2: Buyer wants to pay or chat outside the app
column4: A buyer asks for your phone, email, bank details, or to pay another way.
column5: Thanks for asking! I only sell through [Vinted or Depop], so the payment and the parcel are protected for both of us. You can buy it here with the Buy button.
column6: Thanks for asking! I only sell through Vinted, so the payment and the parcel are protected for both of us. You can buy it here with the Buy button.
column9: Never share contact or bank details and never send an item before the app shows it is paid. Report the chat if they push.

column5: Thanks for buying, [name]! Your [item] is on its way today. Tracking is in the app. If you're happy with it, a review would help my shop.
column6: Thanks for buying, Jo! Your wool cardigan is on its way today. Tracking is in the app. If you're happy with it, a review would help my shop.
column9: Ask for an honest review, never for a set number of stars.
